content.text:
Builds cleanly for `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu`, and correctly refuses to compile on the native Linux target.

Summary of the project set up in `benchmark/top/cargo-top-03-winapi/nohook`:
- `Cargo.toml` — declares `winapi = "0.3.9"` (with `winuser`/`libloaderapi` features) as a `[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]` entry, so it's only pulled in when building for Windows.
- `src/main.rs` — a `MessageBoxW` example showing direct WinAPI bindings, gated behind `#[cfg(windows)]`, with a `compile_error!` on other targets so misuse fails fast and clearly.

Verified with `cargo check --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` (succeeds) and plain `cargo check` on Linux (fails with the intended compile error).
